title: Minimum Cost to Merge Stones
goal: Merge adjacent groups of exactly k piles at minimum total cost until one pile remains.
strategy: Every merge removes k-1 piles, which determines feasibility. Interval DP merges subranges to their smallest achievable pile count; add the interval sum only when its length can collapse to one pile.
